newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Zurich expects good result for 1997.
newsitem.headline: Zurich expects good result for 1997.

text.p: Zurich Insurance Co chairman Rolf Hueppi said business in the first months of 1997 had gone as expected and the group forecast a good overall result for the year.
"Business in the first part of the year has been in line with our expectations," Hueppi said in the text of a speech released before the annual shareholders meeting.
"Unless faced with exceptional claims or developments on the capital or currency markets, we expect to achieve another good overall result for the 1997 financial year," he said.
Hueppi did not elaborate on the 1997 forecast.
But at the company's annual news conference in May, he said that the forecast of good results referred to expected double-digit growth.
Zurich in 1996 posted a net profit of 1,138.2 million Swiss francs, up 30.2 percent from the year before.
